subject: Draft engagement schedule + owners — request to confirm stakeholders
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healmate.com>; Laura Chen <laura.chen@healmate.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: draft engagement schedule and proposed owners

Hi Samir & Laura — thanks again for the call today. Appreciated the clear context on data residency and the priority use cases for triage automation. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass engagement schedule (MAP v0.1) that lays out milestones, suggested owners, and a couple of timeline options.

Highlights from the call (short):
- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for triage automation across 2 hospitals (pilot scope defined).
- Key constraint: all logs to remain within US regions; procurement requires SOC2 evidence and custom PO terms.
- Success metric: 50% reduction in triage handling time for pilot workflow.

What I attached:
- Redwood_MAP_v0.1.xlsx — Milestones, owners, dependencies, and two close-window scenarios (aggressive and conservative).
- Discovery recording link included in HubSpot.

Asks:
1) Please confirm the stakeholder roster in column B of the MAP (I filled in names from our call but want to verify).
2) Which close-window do you prefer (Option A: target close 2027-01-31, Option B: target close 2027-03-31)?
3) Procurement contact (name/email) so we can start the SOC2 evidence packet and legal intake.

Next steps from our side: Karthik will prepare an infra checklist for the pilot, Ben will scope a pilot support plan, and I’ll update the MAP based on your feedback.

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0147 | monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Link: https://drive.example.com/file/d/1a2b3c-Redwood_MAP_v0.1]
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healmate.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@healmate.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: draft engagement schedule and proposed owners

Monica — thanks for the recap and the MAP draft. Quick notes after syncing with Laura this morning: we like Option B (conservative close, end of March) given internal QA and procurement cycles.

Stakeholder confirmations (please update MAP column B):
- Clinical sponsor: Laura Chen (laura.chen@healmate.com) — confirmed
- IT lead: Marcus Reed (marcus.reed@healmate.com) — will be primary infra contact
- Procurement: ProcureOps (procureops@healmate.com) — I'll loop in our contracts rep separately

Procurement ask: they will need the SOC2 report, a model dataflow diagram, and draft SLAs. Can you confirm who on Redwood will own each?

Also attaching the recording tomorrow would be helpful for our internal stakeholders who missed the call.

Thanks,
Samir

--
Samir Khan | Director, Digital Transformation
Healmate
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healmate.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: draft engagement schedule and proposed owners

Thanks Samir — added Marcus Reed in the infra row of the MAP and noted Option B as the preferred close-window.

For procurement checklist ownership:
- SOC2 report: Monica will provide the latest snapshot (public SOC2 summary + redacted report)
- Model dataflow diagram: I’ll produce a one-page diagram showing inference paths, KV caching, and logs (will deliver draft by 2026-11-18)
- Draft SLAs: Ben will propose pilot-level SLAs and escalation paths (ben, can you confirm estimated delivery?)

Ben, any blockers on SLA draft? If not, can you commit to EOW Friday for a first draft?

Best,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healmate.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@healmate.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: draft engagement schedule and proposed owners

Confirming I can turn around a pilot SLA draft by EOD Friday (2026-11-13). I added one suggested dependency to the MAP: procurement will need 10 business days after receiving SOC2 + SLAs to route a PO internally — I put that as a separate milestone under procurement intake.

Also recommending we add a short internal checkpoint for "data processing agreement review" after the infra diagram is shared so legal can pre-clear the clause set.

I'll mark my owner rows in the spreadsheet and push v0.2 shortly.

--
Ben Carter | Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@healmate.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healmate.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@healmate.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: draft engagement schedule and proposed owners

Thank you — Option B (target close 2027-03-31) works for us. Marcus Reed is our IT lead (cc omitted) and ProcureOps will be handling the PO. ProcureOps, please expect SOC2 + SLA docs from Redwood next week.

One more ask: can Redwood add an explicit milestone for the pilot runbook (week-of verification steps + rollback criteria)? That will help our clinical team sign off.

Monica/Karthik/Ben — once you upload v0.2 including the runbook milestone and procurement buffer, I'll confirm final stakeholder list and we can set a MAP kickoff for the week of 11/22.

Best,
Laura

--
Laura Chen | Clinical Program Lead, Healmate
